job.job_description:
SupplyCopia Software Services Private Limited is looking for Back-end Developer to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Designing and developing scalable, high-performance web applications using Node.js and related technologies such as Express.js, React.js, and MongoDB.
Writing server-side code to handle HTTP requests, process data, and interact with databases.
Designing and implementing RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications.
Debugging and fixing bugs in existing applications.
Developing and maintaining automated testing and deployment processes.



Hands-on experience required on NodeJS along with MySQL, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch
Strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools
